name: test_drain_cost_cap_lq2162_20261111
comment: ANCHOR: DRAIN-COST-CAP-LQ2162 — llm-deferred-drain returns a request refused by a per-process daily cost cap to the queue (next window, attempt-bounded) instead of marking it failed, stops paying attempts for a capped process within the batch, and exits 0 for pure cap deferrals; real errors and exhausted attempts still fail.
